decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal, and disruptive enchantments to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own win conditions. The deck aims to play a reactive game, using cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Swords to Plowshares to answer threats, while also using cards like Dress Down and Back to Basics to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes alternative win conditions like Thundertrap Trainer and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to close out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping out powerful threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void. By utilizing cards that can generate additional mana like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, this deck is able to accelerate its game plan and put pressure on the opponent early. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and a way to close out the game quickly. Overall, this deck is built to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy in the Legacy format.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to lock down the opponent's mana base while playing aggressive threats. The deck utilizes cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while also deploying powerful creatures like Fury and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure. The deck aims to control the game by limiting the opponent's options and overwhelming them with high-impact threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Sundering Eruption provides additional versatility and reach in dealing with various threats.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back onto the battlefield for a significant advantage. It also focuses on disruption and protection with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier while also having backup options like Murktide Regent for a strong board presence. It utilizes a mix of control, card draw, and reanimation to dominate the game.

The main idea behind this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void while deploying aggressive threats like Pyrogoyf and Fury. The deck aims to control the board early on and finish the game with efficient creatures or burn spells. With a combination of fast mana acceleration like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, along with powerful cards like The One Ring and Sundering Eruption, this deck looks to apply early pressure and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This Esper Vial deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Aether Vial and various creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. By consistently putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Baleful Strix and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, while controlling the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their own game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck's strategy without sacrificing its consistency.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands as a control mechanism to disrupt opponent's strategies and generate value. By efficiently managing resources like lands, it aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while building up its own win condition. The combination of various land cards such as Dark Depths, Thespian's Stage, and Wasteland allows for both disruption and acceleration. Additionally, cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration provide card advantage and mana ramp, while other spells like Mox Diamond and Swords to Plowshares offer further utility and removal options. By controlling the game through land manipulation, this deck aims to outlast and outvalue opponents in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate a game-winning threat, such as Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and resource management.

This deck focuses on playing powerful creatures for free with the help of cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The goal is to cheat out big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn quickly to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes a lot of card draw and counterspells to protect the combo and ensure its success. The combination of explosive plays and protection makes this deck a formidable force in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The key concept of this deck is to assemble a combo using Mystic Forge and artifacts like Manifold Key, Voltaic Key, and City of Traitors to generate mana and manipulate the top of the library. Karn, the Great Creator can be used to fetch crucial artifacts like Candelabra of Tawnos and Basalt Monolith. Glaring Fleshraker can be used as a control element while cards like Kozilek's Command and The One Ring provide additional utility. This deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifact synergies.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token quickly. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Knight of the Reliquary to search for the combo pieces efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Sylvan Safekeeper to protect the combo from removal spells. Mox Diamond helps ramp up the mana, while Swords to Plowshares deals with opposing threats. The strategy revolves around setting up the combo as fast as possible to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on using a combination of land tutoring, control cards, and powerful creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building towards a win condition. It utilizes cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Life from the Loam, and Crop Rotation to search for key lands such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. Additionally, the deck has access to removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Endurance to deal with threats, along with solid card draw options like Sylvan Library to maintain card advantage.

The focus of the deck is to quickly disrupt and overwhelm the opponent with powerful aggro creatures like Magus of the Moon and Pyrogoyf, along with disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to lock the opponent out of their resources while ramping up its own mana through cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide. By utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful disruptive elements, the deck aims to quickly advance its game plan and secure victory before the opponent can mount a defense.

The key strategy of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Cori-Steel Cutter, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. The addition of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder helps ensure consistency in drawing cards and finding crucial pieces. Overall, this deck aims to maintain control of the board while swiftly closing out the game with its aggressive tempo plays.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, and then bringing them back into play with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The goal is to cheat out high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The use of fetch lands and dual lands ensures consistent mana fixing for the powerful spells in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Pyroblast, Goblin Welder, and Painter's Servant to set up powerful combos with cards like Grindstone, Phyrexian Devourer, and Phyrexian Dragon Engine. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and disrupt opponents with cards like Red Elemental Blast. The deck also includes powerful artifacts and mana acceleration to help set up its combos quickly. The strategy revolves around using a mix of aggressive and disruptive elements to quickly assemble a winning combination.
